about: Expected routing and launcher for model-delegation: whether the skill loads, and where an agent runs (a separate T3 thread, a subagent inside the thread, or nothing). These are expectations for a model graded run over a transcript; tests/test_external_practices.py checks the shape only and runs no model.

cases.message: lanza un agente que revise el PR 84 de agents y me diga si esta listo para merge
cases.situation: A T3 session in the agents repo; the T3 tools are available.
cases.check: t3_thread_launch or a subagent (Agent tool or delegate_task), with the size choice named; no tmux, ssh with a CLI, nohup or background claude -p or codex exec

cases.message: lanza un agente que me diga en que linea de hooks/registry.json se registra pr-door.sh
cases.situation: A T3 session in the agents repo; he says agente, the work is one grep.
cases.check: A subagent inside the thread (Agent tool or delegate_task), or the grep done directly; no t3_thread_launch for a one-line lookup

cases.message: Lanza una sesion para que termine el port de Hollowmere a Booga Linux, la quiero ver en t3code
cases.situation: A T3 session in the agents repo; booga-linux is a registered T3 project.
cases.check: t3_thread_launch on the booga-linux project (projectId from t3_project_list); not a subagent and not a terminal launcher

cases.message: Start a separate agent to update the conocerd-web dependencies on its own branch and open the PR.
cases.situation: A T3 session in the agents repo; conocerd-web is a registered T3 project.
cases.check: t3_thread_launch with a worktree workspaceStrategy on conocerd-web; no tmux, ssh or background CLI

cases.message: lanza un subagnete que busque donde se registra el hook pr-door.sh y me diga la linea
cases.situation: A T3 session in the agents repo.
cases.check: The Agent tool or delegate_task inside this thread, or the lookup done directly; no t3_thread_launch for a one-line lookup

cases.message: lanza un agente en la laptop que retome lo de repuestos santiago donde lo dejamos
cases.situation: A T3 session on agentbox; the handoff skill also matches 'retome'.
cases.check: `agents t3-launch --host laptop`, or, when it fails (the laptop asleep, or no relay set up there yet), a plain statement of that failure; never ssh to the laptop to start claude or tmux there, and never a block for him to paste

cases.message: Necesito tres datos rapidos de este repo: cuantas skills tienen evals/routing.json, cuantos hooks registra hooks/registry.json y si rules/CLAUDE.md tiene algun em dash. Repartelo en agentes en paralelo.
cases.situation: A T3 session in the agents repo; three lookups of seconds each, and he says agents.
cases.check: Subagents inside the thread (Agent tool or delegate_task), or the lookups done directly; no t3_thread_launch for seconds of work

cases.message: Implement retry with backoff in kino's sync worker; if part of it is mechanical, hand it to a cheaper model and keep the tricky part yourself.
cases.situation: A T3 session; the old trigger of the skill, a generic implementation request that weighs delegation and model choice.
cases.check: The skill loads to weigh delegation and model; any handoff is a subagent inside this thread with its type, never a T3 thread launch or a terminal launcher

cases.message: Como funcionan los subagentes de Claude Code en general? solo explicame
cases.situation: A T3 session; a question, not a request to launch anything.
cases.check: An explanation with no Skill call for model-delegation and no launch of any kind

cases.message: hazme el handoff para agentbox de lo que hicimos hoy
cases.situation: Elias wants the paste-ready block, not a launch.
cases.check: The handoff skill, no t3_thread_launch and no delegate_task

cases.message: dime que sesiones de tmux hay abiertas en agentbox
cases.situation: A read-only status question that shares the word tmux and sessions.
cases.check: A tmux ls style read; no agent launched

cases.message: explicame que hace hooks/pr-door.sh y cuando reescribe el comando
cases.situation: A read-only question about a file in the repo.
cases.check: The file read and explained, no launch

cases.message: Quiero que te vayas preparando para mover todo a Agent Box, porque pronto tendre que irme y apagar la computadora. No tienes que hacerlo ahorita, pero cuando sea seguro mueve cada cosa para alla
cases.situation: A laptop session orchestrating Kino work, 18 Oct 2026; the message never says agent, session or thread.
cases.check: `agents t3-launch --host agentbox` with the brief as message, and the thread title given to him; no tmux, no ssh starting claude, no handoff block for him to paste

cases.message: heading out in 10, shift whatever is still running over to agentbox so it keeps going while the laptop is off
cases.situation: A laptop session with work in progress; casual English.
cases.check: `agents t3-launch --host agentbox` for the work he moved (his message moves it, so the launch-in-t3 hook passes it); never asks him to open the thread

cases.message: Arregla estos diez bugs del backlog de conocerd-web, cada uno en su PR, y avisame cuando esten todos en dev
cases.situation: A session in the conocerd-web repo, ten small independent fixes, he did not ask for sessions or threads
cases.check: Each PR is a subagent in its own worktree (Agent tool with isolation worktree, or delegate_task), two at a time; no t3_thread_launch, create_threads or agents t3-launch, and no continuation thread
